map.单词逆序规则（本页代码口径，按模式分三种）：space 模式按空白切分并保留分隔: Word reversal rules (as implemented on this page, three modes): space mode splits on whitespace and reverses the whole group while keeping the separators; zhchar mode extracts tokens one by one (a single Chinese character / a run of letters and digits / whitespace / any other character) and reverses them; allchar mode reverses every character. With "keep punctuation" checked, punctuation and whitespace tokens stay in place and the remaining tokens are filled back in reverse order. Validation: no strict validation; an empty line outputs nothing. Criteria: the mode and the "keep punctuation" checkbox together determine the output shape.
